candidates.description: Pierce: Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage.
candidates.attributes: + 50 Damage; + 50 Attack Speed; + 50 Attack Range (Melee Only)

candidates.name: Eye of Skadi
candidates.description: Cold Attack: Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -25% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

candidates.name: Maelstrom
candidates.description: Chain Lightning: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

candidates.name: Desolator
candidates.description:
Corruption: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.
Soul Stealer: Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.
candidates.notes: Armor reduction works on buildings.

candidates.name: Heaven's Halberd
candidates.description: Disarm: Prevents a target from attacking for 3.5 seconds.

candidates.name: Nullifier
candidates.description: Nullify: Dispels the target and applies a debuff for 4 seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
candidates.notes: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

candidates.name: Lotus Orb
candidates.description: Echo Shell: Applies a shield to the target unit for 5 seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster. The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
candidates.notes: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.
candidates.attributes: + 10 Armor; + 6.5 Health Regeneration; + 4.0 Mana Regeneration; + 250 Mana

candidates.name: Guardian Greaves
candidates.description:
Mend: Restores 325 health and 200 mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster. Radius: 1200 Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
Guardian Aura: Grants 2.5 health regeneration and 1.5 mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below 25%, their health regeneration is increased to 14.5. Radius: 1200
candidates.notes: Mend does not affect units that have been affected by Mend or Mekansm Restore within Guardian Greaves' cooldown.
candidates.attributes: + 50 Movement Speed; + 5 Armor; + 150 Mana; + 1.0 Mana Regeneration

candidates.name: Aether Lens
candidates.notes: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

candidates.name: Crimson Guard
candidates.description:
Guard: For 7 seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a 100% chance to block damage equal to 70 plus 2% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack. Radius: 1200
Damage Block: Grants a 60% chance to block 75 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 50 damage on ranged.
candidates.notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack. When the Guard buff is applied to ranged heroes, Guard blocks 25 less damage. Guard does not affect units that have been affected by Guard within Crimson Guard's cooldown.

candidates.name: Bloodthorn
candidates.description:
Soul Rend: Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 60% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage. All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to 50 if the attacker is a hero, and 25, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.
Pierce: Grants each attack a 40% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.
candidates.attributes: + 25 Intelligence; + 70 Attack Speed; + 4 Mana Regeneration; + 20 Damage

candidates.name: Glimmer Cape
candidates.description: Glimmer: After a 0.5 second delay, grants invisibility, 20 movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to 375 damage to you or a target allied unit for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling.

possibleAbilities.name: Shadowraze
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

possibleAbilities.name: Shadowraze
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

possibleAbilities.name: Shadowraze
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

possibleAbilities.name: Feast of Souls
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost. Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

possibleAbilities.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.

possibleAbilities.name: Requiem of Souls
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

possibleAbilities.name: Necromastery
possibleAbilities.description: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30% of them from bondage.

possibleAbilities.name: Stifling Dagger
possibleAbilities.description: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65+30% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.

possibleAbilities.name: Phantom Strike
possibleAbilities.description: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

possibleAbilities.name: Blur
possibleAbilities.description: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.

possibleAbilities.name: Fan of Knives
possibleAbilities.description: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

possibleAbilities.name: Immaterial
possibleAbilities.description: Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks. Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

possibleAbilities.name: Coup de Grace
possibleAbilities.description: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.

possibleAbilities.name: Crystal Nova
possibleAbilities.description: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.

possibleAbilities.name: Frostbite
possibleAbilities.description: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.

possibleAbilities.name: Arcane Aura
possibleAbilities.description: Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration. Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

possibleAbilities.name: Crystal Clone
possibleAbilities.description: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

possibleAbilities.name: Glacial Guard
possibleAbilities.description: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

possibleAbilities.name: Freezing Field
possibleAbilities.description: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.

possibleAbilities.name: Stop Freezing Field
possibleAbilities.description: Immediately stops the Freezing Field

possibleAbilities.name: Earth Spike
possibleAbilities.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.

possibleAbilities.name: Hex
possibleAbilities.description: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.

possibleAbilities.name: Mana Drain
possibleAbilities.description: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.

possibleAbilities.name: To Hell and Back
possibleAbilities.description: Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead. Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

possibleAbilities.name: Finger of Death
possibleAbilities.description: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target. After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed. Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.

possibleAbilities.name: Storm Hammer
possibleAbilities.description: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

possibleAbilities.name: Great Cleave
possibleAbilities.description: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

possibleAbilities.name: Warcry
possibleAbilities.description: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.

possibleAbilities.name: God's Strength
possibleAbilities.description: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.

possibleAbilities.name: Wrath of God
possibleAbilities.description: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

possibleAbilities.name: Smoke Screen
possibleAbilities.description: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.

possibleAbilities.name: Blink Strike
possibleAbilities.description: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

possibleAbilities.name: Tricks of the Trade
possibleAbilities.description: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.

possibleAbilities.name: Backstab
possibleAbilities.description: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.

possibleAbilities.name: Cloak and Dagger
possibleAbilities.description: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

possibleAbilities.name: Overwhelming Odds
possibleAbilities.description: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a 100% impact slow for 0.3s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.

possibleAbilities.name: Press The Attack
possibleAbilities.description: Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time. DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

possibleAbilities.name: Moment of Courage
possibleAbilities.description: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.

possibleAbilities.name: Outfight Them!
possibleAbilities.description: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.

possibleAbilities.name: Duel
possibleAbilities.description: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.

possibleAbilities.name: Thunder Strike
possibleAbilities.description: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for x1.75 seconds. Provides vision of its target.

possibleAbilities.name: Glimpse
possibleAbilities.description: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.

possibleAbilities.name: Kinetic Field
possibleAbilities.description: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.

possibleAbilities.name: Kinetic Fence
possibleAbilities.description: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

possibleAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
possibleAbilities.description: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.

possibleAbilities.name: Static Storm
possibleAbilities.description: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

possibleAbilities.name: Quas
possibleAbilities.description: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.

possibleAbilities.name: Wex
possibleAbilities.description: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.

possibleAbilities.name: Exort
possibleAbilities.description: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.

possibleAbilities.name: Invoked Spell
possibleAbilities.description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

possibleAbilities.name: Invoked Spell
possibleAbilities.description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

possibleAbilities.name: Invoke
possibleAbilities.description: Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level. Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels 6, 12, and 18. Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen. Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.

possibleAbilities.name: Cold Snap
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.

possibleAbilities.name: Ghost Walk
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.

possibleAbilities.name: Tornado
possibleAbilities.description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

possibleAbilities.name: E.M.P.
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.

possibleAbilities.name: Alacrity
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

possibleAbilities.name: Chaos Meteor
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.

possibleAbilities.name: Sun Strike
possibleAbilities.description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

possibleAbilities.name: Forge Spirit
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.

possibleAbilities.name: Ice Wall
possibleAbilities.description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

possibleAbilities.name: Deafening Blast
possibleAbilities.description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

possibleAbilities.name: Arcane Bolt
possibleAbilities.description: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.

possibleAbilities.name: Concussive Shot
possibleAbilities.description: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range. Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.

possibleAbilities.name: Ancient Seal
possibleAbilities.description: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.

possibleAbilities.name: Shield of the Scion
possibleAbilities.description: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.

possibleAbilities.name: Mystic Flare
possibleAbilities.description: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2 seconds.
